leadHtml:
CAMERA V0.27.0 BETA

@fzlt/core/camera

The page is the camera. Pan and zoom a DOM stage (any element) with one transform written through the engine's ledger, so Recall gives it back exactly. Moves ease and settle (the engine sleeps when they end); with reduced motion they jump. contain (default on) keeps the stage covering its own box, so no edge shows and the page never scrolls sideways. Coordinates: world = the stage's own untransformed CSS px (0,0 is its top-left corner); screen = the same box after the camera (what the visitor sees, in the stage's untransformed layout box).

rest.html:
EXAMPLE · typechecked against v0.27.0
const cam = camera(e, stage, { min: 1, max: 4 }); // any DOM element
cam.to(320, 180, 2);   // eased; the engine settles when it lands
zoomAt(cam, x, y, 3);  // helpers stand alone: zoomAt, flyTo, fit, toScreen
cam.home();            // e.destroy() gives the transform back exactly

CameraOptions interface BETA

Options for camera(): easing rate, zoom limits, containment and reduced-motion handling.

export interface CameraOptions {
    /** Easing rate per second (default 7; higher is snappier). A move settles in about 6 / ease s. */
    ease?: number;
    /** Zoom limits (default 1 and 4). */
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    /** Keep the stage covering its own box and clip its parent (default true). */
    contain?: boolean;
    /** Ease moves (default: yes, unless the visitor prefers reduced motion; then every move jumps). */
    motion?: boolean;
}

camera function BETA

A camera on stage el: pan and zoom it with one transform written through the engine's ledger (so Recall gives it back). Moves ease and settle; to(), pan() and home() drive it.
